name: 6sense
description: Connect your AI assistant to 6sense to retrieve account insights using natural language. Access account data, 6QA trends, keyword activity, and campaign performance directly in your workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add 6sense to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add 6sense to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.6sense.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the 6sense MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: 6sense provides these MCP tools: revvy_agent, revvy_market_research, and sales_news_agent.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to 6sense?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to 6sense in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
6sense requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
6sense is developed by 6sense. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
